about: What a hero rolls when its Stress reaches the resolve threshold (constants.resolve_at). Afflictions are picked at random by weight; virtues likewise, with constants.virtue_chance deciding which list is used.

rows.name: Abusive
rows.text: Abusive: other heroes gain +4 Stress each hand

rows.name: Hopeless
rows.text: Hopeless: this hero's ability does nothing

rows.name: Selfish
rows.text: Selfish: lose $2 at end of round

rows.name: Stalwart
rows.text: Stalwart: X1.5 Mult, gains no Stress
